tools.name: reply
tools.description: Reply to an email. REQUIRED chain: 1) inbox() or search() to find the email and get message_id, 2) read_email(message_id) to read its content, 3) reply(message_id, body=<your response>). tools.name: forward

REQUIRED chain: 1) inbox() or search() to find the email and get message_id, 2) read_email(message_id) to load its content, 3) forward(message_id, to=<address>).
